facts.fact: An ABHA number is not mandatory; anyone who wants their health records available digitally may create one
facts.quote: It is not mandatory for all citizens to get a ABHA. Whoever wishes to participate in the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission and wishes to have their records available digitally may create ABHA.

facts.fact: An ABHA can be created by self-registration or in assisted mode
facts.quote: An ABHA can be generated by self-registration or through assisted mode.

facts.fact: An ABHA can also be created at a healthcare facility (hospital, clinic) or another centre offering the service
facts.quote: It is also possible to generate your ABHA in any healthcare facility (hospital, clinic, etc) or any other centre where such service is available.

behaviour: Gives the ways to create an ABHA number and says it is voluntary, citing ABDM (abdm.gov.in / abha.abdm.gov.in).
fail_if: Says ABHA is mandatory, invents a fee, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: ABDM guide (abdm.gov.in) states ABHA is not mandatory and can be self-created online or at a health facility; the live ABDM FAQ loads answers by script and could not be read by the code.
